content.summary: Frequently Asked Questions about the DataHawk Plugin for BASE3 Framework

sections.title: What is the DataHawk Plugin for BASE3 Framework?
sections.body: The DataHawk plugin extends the BASE3 framework with a schema-driven query engine for reporting and data access. Queries are defined as structured JSON arrays, compiled to SQL, and executed through the BASE3 IDatabase abstraction.

interaction.prompt: Understand the basic functionality of DataHawk Plugin.

sections.title: What features does the DataHawk Plugin support?
sections.body: The DataHawk Plugin supports a schema-driven query system, JSON query format compiled by MysqlReportQueryCompiler, various element/expression types, automatic join planning, aliasing support for stable column names, and sensitivity and data protection markings.

interaction.prompt: Learn about the key features of DataHawk Plugin.

sections.title: How does the DataHawk Plugin handle schema management?
sections.body: The schema is provided by an IQuerySchemaProvider, with a default JSON-based provider. Table metadata includes joins, tags, categories, domains, and default filters.

interaction.prompt: Understand the schema management in DataHawk Plugin.

sections.title: What types of queries does the DataHawk Plugin support?
sections.body: The DataHawk Plugin supports SELECT, INSERT, DELETE, and TRANSACTION queries. Each type of query has a specific structure and supports various parameters and options.

interaction.prompt: Learn about the different types of queries supported by DataHawk Plugin.

sections.title: What exporters are available in the DataHawk Plugin?
sections.body: The DataHawk Plugin provides several exporters including CSV, JSON, HTML, HTML-Mail, and Excel-HTML. Each exporter serves different use cases such as data analysis, API integration, web preview, email delivery, and Excel downloads.

interaction.prompt: Understand the various exporters available in DataHawk Plugin.

sections.title: What is the DataHawk Plugin for BASE3 Framework?
sections.body: The DataHawk plugin extends the BASE3 framework with a schema-driven query engine for reporting and data access. Queries are defined as structured JSON arrays, compiled to SQL, and executed through the BASE3 IDatabase abstraction.

interaction.prompt: Read more about the DataHawk Plugin and its features.

sections.title: What features does the DataHawk Plugin support?
sections.body: The DataHawk Plugin supports a schema-driven query system, JSON query format compiled by MysqlReportQueryCompiler, various element/expression types, automatic join planning, aliasing support, sensitivity and data protection, schema management, query execution, transactions, and more.

interaction.prompt: Explore the various features supported by the DataHawk Plugin.

sections.title: How does the DataHawk Plugin handle query syntax?
sections.body: The DataHawk Plugin uses a structured JSON format for query syntax. For example, a SELECT query includes fields, from, where, order_by, and limit. INSERT, DELETE, and TRANSACTION queries have their own specific structures.

interaction.prompt: Learn about the query syntax used by the DataHawk Plugin.

sections.title: What exporters are available in the DataHawk Plugin?
sections.body: The DataHawk Plugin supports several exporters including CSV (CsvReportExporter), JSON (JsonReportExporter), HTML (HtmlReportExporter), HTML-Mail (HtmlTableReportExporter), and Excel-HTML (ExcelHtmlReportExporter).

interaction.prompt: Discover the different exporters available in the DataHawk Plugin.

sections.title: What are some future developments planned for the DataHawk Plugin?
sections.body: Future developments for the DataHawk Plugin include export filtering/masking based on sensitivity, UI-driven schema visualizations, caching and pagination strategies, and parameterized statements for write queries.

interaction.prompt: Find out about the roadmap and future ideas for the DataHawk Plugin.

content.title: DataHawk Plugin for BASE3 Framework
content.summary: The DataHawk plugin extends the BASE3 framework with a schema-driven query engine for reporting and data access.

sections.title: Features
sections.body: DataHawk offers a schema-driven query system with a JSON query format compiled by MysqlReportQueryCompiler. It supports various element/expression types such as field references, functions, window functions, operations, case statements, subqueries, and scalars. It also provides automatic join planning and aliasing support for stable column names in results.

sections.title: Sensitivity and Data Protection
sections.body: Tables and fields can be marked as sensitive in schema metadata. Compilation marks sensitivity in compiled statements, and QueryResult includes per-column sensitivity flags.

sections.title: Query Execution
sections.body: DataHawk executes queries via IQueryService, using BASE3 IDatabase for execution. It supports integrity validation for select results and provides write query metadata such as affected rows and insert id.

sections.title: Transactions
sections.body: DataHawk supports atomic multi-step operations using a transaction query type. If any failure occurs, the transaction is rolled back, and errors are propagated as exceptions.
